title: therealaleph/MasterHttpRelayVPN-RUST
claim: therealaleph/MasterHttpRelayVPN-RUST — Rust port of @masterking32's MasterHttpRelayVPN — all credit to @masterking32 for the original idea and Python implement
why_good: A Rust port of an existing HTTP-relay VPN — faster/safer than the original, but a reimplementation of someone else's idea, credited as such.
value: Little standalone business; the value is engineering, not a novel product or a buyer who pays.
risk: Not original, grey-area networking use, and no moat over the upstream project or commercial VPNs.
pick_reason: The project is a port of an existing tool and lacks a unique value proposition or clear monetization strategy.
